comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Redhill MRT about 790 m, Orchard Boulevard MRT about 940 m; closer than 26 of 551 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Alexandra Primary School about 360 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 500 m), more than 121 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48); nearest hawker centre Beo Crescent Market about 780 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 520 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 890 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 950 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,120 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,170 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,190 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,280 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,350 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 1,560 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 245 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,721 new sales and 1,004 resales (2,725 purchases); new sales were 63.2% of these purchases. Subsales (11) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,004 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 272 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,004 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,160 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−13.4%). Planning-area private resales −14%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
